description: Actuator headroom under the fail-secure hold (registered before running, reviewer R2.6): same plant, AGC and receiver as EXP-008, with per-governor mechanical power and TGOV1 limits logged. Hypothesis: for load ramps up to 0.1 pu/min no governor reaches its upper limit VMAX before the frequency leaves the steady-state band, so the analytical hold time (which assumes unsaturated droop) is valid; at 0.2 pu/min a limit may be reached.

limits_ASSUMPTION.source: frequency-quality defining parameters of Commission Regulation (EU) 2017/1485 (SOGL), Annex III, Continental Europe: max steady-state deviation 200 mHz, max instantaneous 800 mHz; applied to the 60 Hz test case as an illustrative limit, not a claim about any real system
